name: Comedy Subdomain
body:
Associated Domains: Chaos, Madness.

Replacement Power: The following granted power replaces the chaos blade power of the Chaos domain or the aura of madness power of the Madness domain.

Slapstick Spell (Su)

At 8th level, spells with the emotion descriptor you cast are automatically affected as if by the Blissful Spell metamagic feat, but with no increase in spell level. These spells don’t gain the good descriptor, and even spells with the evil descriptor can be modified this way.

Replacement Domain Spells: 1st—hideous laughter, 2nd—absurdity, 4th—symbol of laughter.
